findings.what: The emitter now adds two spaces to every continuation line, but the diff only changes the test's message; any real caller still writing its own `\n  ` indent (such as the flock refusal the old test copied, or refuse_version_skew's paragraphs) will now print with four spaces unless those call sites are updated in the same change.

Only an exactly empty line is left unindented, so a line that holds only whitespace (or a leftover `\r` from a CRLF message, if sanitise_multiline keeps it) still gets a two-space indent and so has trailing whitespace, which the comment says cannot happen.
